data_foundation_scope.scope_note: all prepared UWM data-foundation assets may be used, but claims are gated by synthetic_status, source_type, access_status and artifact-level evidence

increase_green_infrastructure.business_meaning: increase green/cooling infrastructure for high heat-risk units
increase_green_infrastructure.expected_primary_effect: decrease heat_risk and improve livability/equity through the simulator

traffic_emission_control.business_meaning: apply traffic-emission controls for high pollution-exposure units

add_community_service.business_meaning: add or improve community services for low-accessibility units
add_community_service.expected_primary_effect: increase service_accessibility and equity through the simulator

claim_boundary.reason: The audit checks whether authoritative governance rows link across required tables. It does not create governance data and does not prove observed policy outcome superiority.
The gate checks whether production actions may bind to authoritative governance data before planner search. It does not create data, deploy policy, or prove observed outcomes.

The registry turns current UWM actions into explicit spatial causal questions and estimand contracts. Existing data support algorithmic causal diagnostics and conditional simulation, but not observed policy-effect identification.
Full-admin planner replay uses all current admin graph nodes and simulator rollouts; it is not observed policy-outcome evidence.

claim_guard.rule: synthetic, semi_synthetic, fitted_proxy and smoke-only assets may support development or exploratory scaffolds, but cannot support observed policy outcome superiority claims
